title: VDO instrument cluster, VWK501 ROM (VW Mk4 / B5 era)

checksums.name: Gauge / K-value checksum
checksums.description: Checksum byte + region 1 (K-value) + region 2 (speedometer map) must sum to 0xFF (mod 256), or the cluster shows 'dEF'.

patch_module.description: CDC16xxF-E memory-patch block: 6-byte header (H0 checksum, H1 data length, H2/H3 code length, H4/H5 target ROM version) then 6502 code and the patch table. Bound to one exact ROM build.

parameters.name: K-value (distance impulse number)
parameters.heading: Speed & distance
parameters.description: Impulses per km the cluster counts for speed and distance. Only used when coding digit 5 (distance impulse number) is not overriding it. Wheel revolutions per km x gearbox sender pulses per revolution (7 on Golf/Jetta, 8 on most others). Covered by the gauge checksum, corrected on save.

parameters.name: Speedometer calibration
parameters.heading: Speed & distance
parameters.description: Speedometer needle map: row 1 is the speed value at each calibration point, row 2 the stepper-motor needle position for it. To correct a speedometer that reads N% high, divide the needle positions by (1 + N/100). Covered by the gauge checksum, corrected on save.

parameters.name: Tachometer calibration
parameters.heading: Gauges
parameters.description: Tachometer needle map: value at each calibration point and the stepper position for it. Differs by gauge face (diesel vs petrol tach).

parameters.name: Fuel gauge calibration
parameters.heading: Gauges
parameters.description: Fuel gauge needle map.

parameters.name: Fuel level sender calibration
parameters.heading: Gauges
parameters.description: Fuel level sender linearisation (tank sender reading to level).

parameters.name: Coolant temperature gauge calibration
parameters.heading: Gauges
parameters.description: Coolant temperature needle map. The flat middle section is the deliberate 'needle parks at 90' band.

parameters.name: Fuel consumption correction
parameters.heading: Speed & distance
parameters.description: Trip computer fuel consumption trim.

parameters.name: Coding: distance impulse number
parameters.heading: Coding (soft coding digits)
parameters.description: Soft-coding digit 5. Picks one of the K-values burned into the ROM; which table depends on the vehicle family (see 'Vehicle family'). 0 uses the impulses from CAN.

parameters.name: Coding: service intervals
parameters.heading: Coding (soft coding digits)

options.0x00: Fixed intervals, no oil level/temp sensor
options.0x01: Flexible intervals (LongLife), with oil level/temp sensor
options.0x02: Fixed intervals, with oil level/temp sensor

parameters.description: Soft-coding digit 4.

parameters.name: Coding: country
parameters.heading: Coding (soft coding digits)
parameters.description: Soft-coding digit 3: country / units variant.

parameters.name: Coding: brake pad wear warning
parameters.heading: Coding (soft coding digits)
parameters.description: Soft-coding digits 1-2, bit 0x01.

parameters.name: Coding: seatbelt warning
parameters.heading: Coding (soft coding digits)
parameters.description: Soft-coding digits 1-2, bit 0x02.

parameters.name: Coding: washer fluid level warning
parameters.heading: Coding (soft coding digits)
parameters.description: Soft-coding digits 1-2, bit 0x04.

parameters.name: Coding: secondary display (radio/navigation)
parameters.heading: Coding (soft coding digits)
parameters.description: Soft-coding digits 1-2, bit 0x10.

parameters.name: Vehicle family
parameters.heading: Vehicle configuration
parameters.description: Low nibble of the vehicle-family byte. Selects which K-value table coding digit 5 uses and the default gearbox pulses per wheel revolution (7 for Golf/Jetta, 8 for the rest). Changing it re-skins the cluster for another chassis -- normally only done when building a cluster for a different car.

parameters.name: ABS / lamp-check configuration
parameters.heading: Vehicle configuration
parameters.description: Byte that drives ABS lamp and bulb-check behaviour; varies by chassis and trim. The listed values are the typical ones per chassis, not the only valid ones -- individual bit meanings are not confirmed.

parameters.name: Speed / coolant temperature signal source
parameters.heading: Vehicle configuration

options.0x00: Speed and coolant temp from sensors
options.0x01: Speed from CAN, coolant temp from sensor
options.0x02: Speed from sensor, coolant temp from CAN
options.0x03: Speed and coolant temp from CAN

parameters.description: Where the cluster takes road speed and coolant temperature from: the hard-wired senders or the CAN bus (ABS / engine ECU). Needed for some engine swaps.

parameters.name: Outside air temperature sensor
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: Outside air temperature display enabled.

parameters.name: Chime above 120 km/h
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: Warning chime when exceeding 120 km/h.

parameters.name: LED configuration (lights off)
parameters.heading: Lighting
parameters.description: What stays lit with the light switch off.

parameters.name: LED on while starting
parameters.heading: Lighting
parameters.description: Illumination on during the start / sweep.

parameters.name: Cruise control lamp when set
parameters.heading: Lighting
parameters.description: Light the cruise lamp while a speed is set.

parameters.name: Ice warning disable temperature
parameters.heading: Ice warning
parameters.description: Outside temperature above which the ice warning clears.

parameters.name: Ice warning enable temperature
parameters.heading: Ice warning
parameters.description: Outside temperature below which the ice warning shows.

parameters.name: Distance to empty
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: Shows the range-to-empty in the trip computer. Whole-byte switch: C1 stock, E1 enabled.

parameters.name: Welcome message
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: Whole-byte switch from the XDF: 6B stock, 02 enabled.

parameters.name: VIN
parameters.heading: Vehicle identity
parameters.description: Vehicle identification number (first VIN slot).

parameters.name: VIN (second slot)
parameters.heading: Vehicle identity
parameters.description: Second VIN slot ('VIN2' in the EEPROM map). In every real dump checked (31, including untouched factory reads) it holds XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX while the first slot holds the car's VIN, so it is kept as its own field rather than treated as a copy.

parameters.name: Part number / ident
parameters.heading: Cluster identity
parameters.description: 18-character ident string, e.g. '1J0920806M  A4V07'. Scan tools read the cluster's identity from here. It describes the cluster hardware (gauge face, trim), so a vehicle-data transfer leaves it alone.

parameters.name: Cluster ID for radio
parameters.heading: Vehicle identity
parameters.description: Value the radio checks over KW1281 to know it is still in the same car. Copy it when replacing a cluster so the radio does not ask for its code.

parameters.name: Immobilizer ID
parameters.heading: Immobilizer
parameters.description: 14-character immobilizer ID, stored three times.

parameters.name: Immobilizer key
parameters.heading: Immobilizer
parameters.description: Engine-ECU binding key: 7 bytes, stored three times at an 8-byte stride (the 8th byte of each slot is FF padding on genuine dumps and is left alone). A write goes to every copy.

parameters.name: Key IDs
parameters.heading: Immobilizer
parameters.description: Learned transponder key data (64 bytes).

parameters.name: Number of keys
parameters.heading: Immobilizer
parameters.description: Keys programmed (stored as count x 17), three copies.

parameters.name: Immobilizer adaptation status
parameters.heading: Immobilizer
parameters.description: 04 not adapted, 06 adapted; three copies.

parameters.name: SKC (login code)
parameters.heading: Immobilizer
parameters.description: Secret key code (PIN) used for login and key adaptation. Stored three times; an edit writes all three.

parameters.name: Odometer
parameters.heading: Odometer
parameters.description: Eight rotating 16-bit counters, each decremented once per 2 km in turn. The odometer reading is the SUM of the eight cells as shown (km). Read-only in the editor: it only moves when a whole cluster's vehicle data is transferred.

parameters.name: Odometer checksum
parameters.heading: Odometer
parameters.description: 7 bytes stored in front of the odometer counters. The algorithm is not known: transfer it together with the odometer, never on its own.

parameters.name: Hardware level tag
parameters.heading: Cluster identity
parameters.description: Two characters near the end of the EEPROM: HL, ML or LL on every sample that has them (high / mid / lowline). Informational.
